how: We read the website of every Orlando wedding DJ listed on Lazo (43 listings, 33 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a national multi-service franchise, an LED-wall and AV rental company, a ballroom venue, a site taken over by casino spam, and a page with nothing on it but a copyright line. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
How do you handle ceremony audio outdoors, and what is the plan if a storm moves things inside?
What is in the base price, and what do uplighting, cold sparks, photo booths and extra hours add?

picks.name: Xclusive Deejays
picks.blurb: Andy Jimenez founded Xclusive Deejays in 2007 after mixing music since age 15, and the site credits his bilingual background for his range. Winter Springs based, with lighting, special effects, decor and photo booths offered alongside the DJ.

picks.name: Empire Entertainment - Indian Wedding DJ Florida
picks.blurb: Empire Entertainment is an Indian wedding DJ company with three decades of music and production, built for modern South Asian weddings. Bollywood, Bhangra and hip-hop from one team that also supplies MCs, sound, lighting and LED walls across Orlando, Tampa and Miami.

picks.name: Kwik Entertainment LLC - DJ Services
picks.blurb: Kwik Entertainment fields a bilingual team of DJs and MCs for weddings, with a photobooth, 360 booth and La Hora Loca on the menu. The pitch is curated playlists and seamless transitions to keep the floor alive, out of Orlando.

picks.name: Our DJ Rocks
picks.blurb: Our DJ Rocks began in 2011 as a female-led vision and now runs an all-female DJ team that is handpicked and trained in-house. The Apopka company works weddings and corporate events and says music is bigger than a playlist.

picks.name: FyerFly Productions
picks.blurb: Jim, aka DJ FyerFly, is a professionally trained DJ and emcee known on his own site as The Chameleon for adapting to any crowd. FyerFly Productions sells a boutique wedding experience with live mixing and lighting, including a lighted canopy at a Ritz-Carlton wedding.

picks.name: Soundwave Entertainment Systems
picks.blurb: Soundwave Entertainment has served Central Florida since 2001 and counts more than 6,000 weddings, owned and managed by husband and wife Les Kopasz and Wendy Goelz. Mixing DJs and MCs, LED lighting design, special effects, photo booths and a guitarist.

picks.name: M.A.D.D. Vybez Entertainment
picks.blurb: M.A.D.D. Vybez has specialized in weddings since 2002 and prints its packages: the Essential covers four hours of reception DJ and MC with four uplights, and the Signature runs five to six hours across ceremony, cocktails and reception.

picks.name: Orlando Dj And Lighting
picks.blurb: Orlando DJ and Lighting pairs DJ and MC service with LED uplighting and pipe and drape, with a music library spanning six decades from the 1930s on. Packages are customizable and the site promises transparent pricing by quote.

picks.name: Elegant Entertainment DJ Services Orlando
picks.blurb: Elegant Entertainment lists its DJ packages on the site, $1,295 to $1,695 at our read, and names its roster: DJs Joe, Leo, Dany, Juan, Christian and Rob. Uplighting, cold sparklers, dancing on a cloud, a photobooth and videography are add-ons.

picks.name: iRock
picks.blurb: iRock grew out of three siblings, Sebastian, Santiago and Daniella, who each spent more than twelve years in Central Florida events before combining into one Ocoee company. DJs, live musicians, lighting, dance floors and photo booths from one crew.

picks.name: Color of Sound Entertainment
picks.blurb: Color of Sound Entertainment in Longwood combines professional DJ entertainment with live music for weddings and private celebrations, and says every aspect of a wedding gets special care in the planning.

picks.name: Dj Live Productions
picks.blurb: Austin Beeghly started DJ Live Productions about 10 years ago in Altamonte Springs, and includes free uplighting on every package with monograms available. Discounts are printed on the site: 20 percent for military and 10 percent for teachers, police, fire and EMS.
